name: Twity
rootCause: The Web3 Twitter marketing platform Twity tweeted that there was a security vulnerability in its system, the Telegram account of the technician was leaked, and the chat record contained project information and wallet private key, resulting in the disclosure of administrator account information. The team is currently holding an emergency meeting to study solutions. All user assets and NFT information will be snapped. The specific solution will be published separately after it is formulated.
